bio: This inn has a long-standing tradition of hospitality. A relaxed atmosphere reigns in the delightful interior, which combines modern elements with rustic charm. Outside, the lovely terrace is shaded by chestnut trees. With an emphasis on organic and locally sourced ingredients, the menu features regional fare and takes its cue from the seasons. Daily specials are also available. For overnight stays, there are well-appointed guestrooms furnished with natural materials and designed with sustainability in mind....
